title: Anansi Tales
tagline: Help Anansi win with wit in five spider tales from Ghana.
description: A wit-and-puzzle storytelling game inspired by the Anansi tales of the Akan people of Ghana. A storyteller and her listeners tell five folk tales; you solve the tricks: sequences, matches, riddles, cause-and-effect traps and clever replies. Painted-cloth art, a Gallery of woven story-cloths, hints and Watch and Learn.
howToPlay: Listen to the storyteller, then solve one small puzzle in each of four beats.
Tap cards in order, match pairs, pick the riddle answer, or build the trap one tool at a time.
A wrong pick shows what would really happen and costs only a star.
Tap Hint for a nudge, again to see the answer; Watch and Learn plays a tale for you.
Finish a tale to hang its woven cloth in the Gallery.
